derivation:
by
  apply Polynomial.Monic.free_adjoinRoot
  simp [powerRootPolynomial, Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C, Nat.ne_of_gt hn]
explanation: Mathlib proves that adjoining a root of any monic polynomial gives a free module. Instantiate the polynomial with X^n − C a; positivity of n establishes monicity. The current proof already applies this declaration.
